capabilities: Display a clock with time and date
Add multiple timezones by IANA zone ID or numeric UTC offset
Choose label styles for unnamed timezones (city, abbreviation, IANA ID, offset)
Open and drag the clock to a preferred location
Customize layout and colors with CSS snippets
extras: Includes an alternative style as a CSS snippet and links a video walkthrough; the author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in clock or multi-timezone display for keeping track of time while working.
summary: Clock display that shows the time and date with multiple configurable timezones in a movable panel.
